_about: Each row is one CS 1.6 HUD element drawn in Minecraft while CS mode is on. sprite = name in the player's own cstrike/sprites/hud.txt (640 set). anchor/x/y are in GUI pixels from that screen corner. source = what Minecraft value it shows.

rows.source: CS kevlar from CsState.armor (bought); suithelmet_full with helmet, suit_empty at 0
CS money CsState.money (economy.json), with +/- flash of the last change
current CS weapon: clip | reserve of its ammo type (ammo.json) + the ammo icon from its sprites/<hud>.txt; grenades: count; knife: hidden
real seconds until dusk (day) or dawn (night) from world time of day
living entities within 32 blocks, rotated with the player's yaw: hostile red, other players white, passive green
food level / 20 fills flash_full over flash_empty; flash_beam shown when food >= 18 (can sprint-heal)
CS 1.6 line crosshair; gap = weapon crosshairGap, wider moving/airborne and while firing; hidden in the sniper scope
kills by the player and the player's deaths, last 5 for 6 s each; icon from killfeed_icons.json
one icon per active row of status_icons.json, stacked downward
